<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914964_theRebbe_974" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914964_theRebbe_974__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Repentance done with joy perfects the subsequent Torah study and mitzvos, making them good and luminous.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to add,</t>
    <t s="1">according to the known explanation</t>
    <t s="2">in the elucidation of the Sages’ phrase</t>
    <t s="3">“repentance and good deeds,”</t>
    <t s="4">that through repentance the deeds</t>
    <t s="5">(of the mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="6">are good and luminous,</t>
    <t s="7">it may be said,</t>
    <t s="8">that since repentance is with joy—for then repentance is in perfection—</t>
    <t s="9">through this there is increase in the joy and in the perfection of Torah study and fulfillment of mitzvos that follow repentance.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This effect of repentance on subsequent Torah and mitzvos is a preparation for the complete redemption, which will include the perfection of the people, the land, and the Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this matter</t>
    <t s="1">[the effect of repentance on Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="2">(the service of the righteous)</t>
    <t s="3">that follow repentance]</t>
    <t s="4">is a proximate preparation for the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="5">who comes to bring the righteous to repentance.</t>
    <t s="6">And likewise regarding the future redemption, there will be these two matters,</t>
    <t s="7">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="8">“In returning and rest you shall be saved,”</t>
    <t s="9">“in returning” refers to the service of repentance,</t>
    <t s="10">and “in rest” refers to the service of the righteous.</t>
    <t s="11">And simply,</t>
    <t s="12">all of Israel,</t>
    <t s="13">“our young and our old, etc., our sons and our daughters”</t>
    <t s="14">[the perfection of the people],</t>
    <t s="15">will return to our holy land,</t>
    <t s="16">and as it is a good and spacious land</t>
    <t s="17">[the perfection of the land],</t>
    <t s="18">together with Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="19">(the service of the righteous).</t>
    <t s="20">And since Torah and mitzvos are preceded by repentance,</t>
    <t s="21">even the Torah and mitzvos are in perfection</t>
    <t s="22">[the perfection of Torah and My mitzvos].</t>
    <t s="23">And all this—in the well-known phrase regarding repentance—“in one moment and in one instant.”</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
